source_name: Dawn (Gulraiz Khan, 'People and the Peoples' Bus Service')

source_name: BOL News ('Karachi Red Bus R9 Routes: Reasonable & Safe Travel')
notes: Route-specific article: hours 'extended' to 7 am-10 pm; R9 headway about 15 min in peak, 30 min off-peak; 42 km Gulshan-e-Hadeed - Tower. Live URL now 404; read from web.archive.org as stripped text. The same 15/30 figures appear network-wide on thinktransportation/rehbar/redbus.shop, so they may be generic rather than measured for R9.

source_name: BOL News ('Karachi People's Bus R11 Routes, Timings, and Fares')
notes: Article on R11 (then Shireen Jinnah Colony - Miran Naka Lyari, 19 km) gives the general PBS figures: 7 am-10 pm daily, every 15 min peak / 30 min off-peak. Not a route-specific measurement.

days_note: Two buses; only morning departures published
source_name: Sindh Mass Transit Authority (official notice)
notes: Re-read on the live SMTA site (same text as round4): 2 EV-5 buses; morning departure 06:00 Bahria Town -> Sohrab Goth, 07:00 Sohrab Goth -> DHA City. No last bus or return times. Duplicate of the round4 entry, kept for completeness.

source_name: Aaj English TV
notes: Double-deckers operate 6am-10pm on Fawara Chowk (Zainab Market) - Malir Halt via Sharea Faisal (opening alignment, 5 buses). Duplicate of round4. No hours found after the 16 Feb 2026 Malir-Tower extension, nor on the SMTA route page smta.gos.pk/routes/27 (24 km, no timings). Dawn, Geo, Tribune, The News and Jang launch reports give no hours or headway; a Dawn reader asked how often they run and got no answer.

source_name: Dawn EOS ('Infrastructure: new buses, old problems', Samina Hassan Laghari & Arif Hasan)
notes: Most recent dated figure: Karachi's electric/hybrid buses are expected at stops at 20-minute intervals 'but that rarely happens'; charging at Mehran Depot (Mominabad) disrupted by power outages. Says 15 white EV-3 buses replaced red buses on Malir Cantt - Numaish. The route of the 20-min figure is not named (writer commutes Gulistan-e-Johar - Muhammad Ali Society). Tribune letter 6 Jun 2026 (https://tribune.com.pk/letter/2257933/late-arriving-ev-buses) also says EV buses often miss the 'published schedule' but gives no times.

days_note: Daily incl. weekends and public holidays; service levels may change on major holidays
source_name: redbus.shop (unofficial guide, 'Updated 13 July 2026')
notes: Network-wide claim for R-series and EV-series: 07:00-22:00, about 15 min in peaks (08-10, 17-20), about 30 min off-peak; no per-route first/last or journey times. Same as rehbar.pk (undated) and thinktransportation.net (whose FAQ also says service runs 'till 8-9 pm' and average wait is 10-15 min). Already reflected in data/systems hours notes.

source_name: Brandsynario
notes: Says buses run 'after every 10-15 minutes or so' on all routes (R1-R4, R9-R12, EV1-EV3); stored as a 10-15 range in peak/off-peak fields. No hours given.

source_name: Graana blog (published 2022-12-13, updated 2024-06-21)
notes: 'Operates daily from 7 AM to 8 PM' on all routes. Conflicts with 07:00-22:00 (Bol 2024, redbus.shop 2026). Zameen blog 23 Feb 2023 also 7 am-8 pm; Wikipedia 8 am-8 pm.

source_name: Dawn ('Pink isn't just a colour, it's a bus!')
notes: Launch report: 8 pink buses on Model Colony - Tower via Sharea Faisal from 7am till 10pm; every 20 min in morning and evening peaks, hourly the rest of the day. Free for the first 7 days (to 7 Feb 2023).

source_name: Gulf News (quoting Sharjeel Memon)
notes: Launch statement: buses available every 20 min from 7am to 11am and from 4pm to 9pm daily. Conflicts with Dawn the same day (07-22, hourly off-peak).

source_name: Dawn (quoting SMTA MD Zubair Channa)
notes: SMTA managing director: pink buses run during peak rush hours 7:30am-10:30am and 4pm-8pm. Official statement via Dawn.

source_name: Think Transportation (undated FAQ section; page first published 2022-06-08)
notes: FAQ: pink buses run on R1, R2, R3, R9, R10 'specifically in peak hours from 8 am and 9 am in the morning and 5 pm and 6pm in the evening'. Undated; low confidence.
